postings.title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
top_requirements: Design and validate end‑to‑end RF payload architectures for direct‑to‑device satellite communications, including link‑budget analysis and on‑orbit performance verification.
Lead hardware development from schematic capture through PCB layout, integration, and thermal‑vacuum testing of high‑frequency transceiver modules.
Develop and execute RF system test plans covering gain, noise figure, IIP3, EVM, and spectral mask compliance across the full payload chain.
bonus_skills: Proficiency in RF simulation tools (ADS, HFSS)
Knowledge of satellite mission operations and on‑orbit testing
postings.summary: The role leads the architecture, design, and on‑orbit validation of RF communications payloads for a satellite connectivity startup. It matches the candidate’s deep RF and communications systems background while offering a senior technical leadership position.

postings.title: Senior Ground Station Systems Engineer
top_requirements: Develop and maintain ground‑station RF front‑end and baseband signal processing chains for geostationary satellite communications.
Perform link‑budget calculations, RF performance testing, and troubleshooting of downlink/up‑link modems and antennas.
Integrate and validate software‑defined radio (SDR) platforms for real‑time telemetry, tracking, and command (TT&C) operations.
bonus_skills: Familiarity with RF test equipment (VNA, spectrum analyzer)
postings.summary: This senior ground‑station systems engineer role focuses on RF and signal‑processing work for satellite communications, directly leveraging the candidate’s experience at Astranis while staying within a technical hands‑on scope.

postings.title: Senior Device Engineer: 3D NAND Flash Memory
top_requirements: Lead the design of 3D NAND flash memory device architectures, including cell layout, stack engineering, and process integration.
Develop and execute electrical characterization test plans (IV, program/erase endurance, retention) for prototype devices.
Collaborate with circuit designers to create custom peripheral circuits and verify performance in silicon through bring‑up and debug.
bonus_skills: Proficiency in Python/Matlab for data analysis
postings.summary: The senior device engineer position involves hands‑on design and validation of advanced NAND flash memory, offering a shift from aerospace to high‑volume semiconductor IC work that aligns with the candidate’s IC design interests.

postings.title: Applications Engineer
top_requirements: Design and verify mixed‑signal ASIC blocks for audio/video processing, including ADC/DAC front‑ends and digital filters.
Create SPICE models and perform Monte‑Carlo simulations to ensure performance across process corners.
Collaborate with layout engineers to resolve signal‑integrity and power‑noise issues in silicon prototypes.
postings.summary: The applications engineer role at Cirrus Logic involves hands‑on mixed‑signal design for consumer audio/video ICs, offering a transition to IC work while staying within the candidate’s signal‑processing skill set.

postings.title: Senior FPGA & DSP Team Lead - Embedded RF/AI
top_requirements: Design FPGA‑based RF detection algorithms and high‑throughput DSP pipelines for counter‑drone radar systems.
Develop and integrate ARM‑based embedded firmware to control SDR front‑ends, manage data streams, and implement real‑time threat classification.
Lead hardware bring‑up, including RF front‑end calibration, timing closure, and performance validation in lab and field environments.
bonus_skills: Experience with GNU Radio and SDR platforms
Knowledge of machine‑learning inference on FPGA
postings.summary: This senior FPGA & DSP team lead position at DroneShield combines hands‑on RF, FPGA, and embedded system work, aligning well with the candidate’s communications and signal‑processing background while moving into a fast‑growing defense‑tech startup.

postings.title: Senior Staff Engineer – Audio/Video DSP & ML on Edge
top_requirements: Develop high‑performance C/C++ audio and video signal‑processing algorithms for edge devices, targeting low‑latency and low‑power operation.
Implement and optimize machine‑learning models for real‑time media enhancement and compression on embedded GPUs/NPUs.
Lead code reviews, performance profiling, and cross‑platform validation across multiple consumer hardware platforms.
bonus_skills: Familiarity with TensorRT or ONNX runtime
Knowledge of audio DSP standards (Dolby, DTS)
postings.summary: The senior staff engineer role at Dolby focuses on cutting‑edge audio/video DSP and ML on edge devices, offering a senior technical path that leverages the candidate’s signal‑processing expertise in a high‑impact consumer‑tech environment.
